key: Off Jacmel. It is dawn on the schooner Ferret. There is no wind, and the sea is full of sharks. You are Jem, the ship's boy, aged twelve. You are fictional. The shark, the papers and the two officers were real.
text: Off Jacmel. It is dawn on the schooner Ferret. There is no wind, and the sea is full of sharks. You are Jem, the ship's boy, aged twelve. You are fictional. The shark, the papers and the two officers were real.

key: What the shark held. The shark lies on the deck. Two of the men open it, to get the pork back.
text: What the shark held. The shark lies on the deck. Two of the men open it, to get the pork back.

key: Port Royal. The Ferret is home. The brig Nancy is here too, waiting for the court.
text: Port Royal. The Ferret is home. The brig Nancy is here too, waiting for the court.

key: The court in Kingston. Mr Fitton has carried the papers across the harbour to Kingston.
text: The court in Kingston. Mister Fitton has carried the papers across the harbour to Kingston.

key: The Shark Papers. A ship's master threw his papers into the sea. A shark swallowed them. A sailor caught the shark. The papers reached the court, and the truth came out. You can still see them in Kingston today.
